title: She Buys $1 Pallets And Sells Them For $5,000 (30 Mins/Day)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: School curriculum arbitrage from GovDeals pallets
idea.one_liner: Win school-district book pallets for ~$1 on GovDeals, use ChatGPT to identify and bundle curriculum sets, sell on eBay with free shipping
idea.offer: used curriculum sets and picture-book bundles
idea.revenue_model: eBay resale; average sale ~$45, sets up to $200-350

key_quotes.quote: I uploaded all of those pictures into ChatGPT and I gave it all of these metrics.
They're usually going for their opening bid which is most of the time a dollar.
There's one curriculum in particular, I think I'm one of three sellers on the entire platform that has it.

claims.claim: Two $1 pallets produced ~$5,000 revenue in 2 months
claims.quote: And my total revenue at that point was around $5,000.
However, the kicker to this is I was spending maybe 3 hours a week on this.
I think my average sale price is Oh, I have it right here. $45.

claims.claim: Most paid for a pallet $32; ~11 pallets, never lost money
claims.quote: The most I've ever paid for a pallet is $32.

claims.claim: SRA sets sell for $60-100 with $7-8 shipping
claims.quote: I sell them left and right for 60 to $100 a set and these are I mean, they cost me seven, eight bucks to ship.

acquisition_channels.details: consistent nightly listings, free shipping, SEO listings from ChatGPT

ideas.delivery: local pickup of pallets within ~250 miles; photograph on white poster board; ship media mail

idea.name: 'Will pick up free books' flyer sourcing for book resale
idea.one_liner: Post flyers or community posts offering to collect unwanted books for free, then resell them online

key_quotes.quote: But anyway, he started in book resale and he just posted a flyer up said will pick up free books.
You could hop on Facebook Marketplace right now and find endless listings of people trying to get rid of books.

acquisition_channels.details: ask for unwanted books or curriculum

idea.name: Live-selling Rent the Runway liquidation on Whatnot
idea.one_liner: Buy blemished Rent the Runway designer clothing pallets on B-Stock at ~$6/item and auction them in Whatnot live shows
idea.revenue_model: live auction resale; e.g. $29 start prices

key_quotes.quote: $5,400 was my total investment for $350,000 of merchandise.
The Whatnot back end of the shipping can be really confusing as a new seller, and if you don't have that dialed in right, you can make a big financial mistake right out of the gate.

claims.claim: $1,200 sales from six 1-hour streams with no following
claims.quote: I've done six 1-hour live streams on there. I've done $1,200 in sales with zero following.

claims.claim: Selling all 900 items at $29 would clear $30k after fees
claims.quote: I'm easy will clear $30,000 after fees.
